opening.argument: The demonstrated process is a disclosed couponing and cashback method: viewers are told to add items to Ibotta, purchase them, upload the receipt, and receive reported cashback. The video reports $17.50 back for 11 offers, a $50 Ulta gift card, and a purchase calculation showing $50.39 out of pocket, $40.22 returned, and $10.17 ultimately spent. It also presents a makeup haul and asks viewers to use an Ibotta referral code. These are stated purchase, coupon, cashback, receipt, and referral conditions, not an unexplained payment or credential solicitation. A separate Lyft referral promotion is not connected to the demonstration or given established eligibility and payout terms.
